progression_review.summary: Pass. The full series now progresses coherently from core conceptual foundations, through specialist topic libraries, into laboratory-style technical application. Language complexity remains controlled even as mathematical sophistication rises, early volumes avoid abrupt abstraction, later volumes retain explanatory framing, and the design/visual strategy now has a clear backlog for further enrichment where conceptual diagrams will matter most.
repair_actions: Added a map projections and CRS bridge chapter to support later spatial measurement work.
Added a foundational remote-sensing ladder so advanced sensing chapters rest on a fairer conceptual base.
Normalized onboarding and notation expectations across all three volumes.
Established an illustration backlog to strengthen conceptual accessibility for visual learners in the most demanding laboratory chapters.
